I loved the idea of this app. At the time I was young and didn’t have much money to save. When I finally started to make more money I was about to use the app, but then I noticed an email that they were closing down the app… It absolutely broke my heart. I felt like I finally found an app that’s aesthetically pleasing, but also allowed me to have a visual representation that stimulated my brain and wanted to save more to see my mountain grow!! I still have never found an app like it and I’m so sad. I want to find the developer’s email(s), because I think if it were just an app to input numbers to vs. attaching actual bank accounts too it would be a lot better (especially for the cost of running an app).
